supersedes: The helper/cache-only scope in the original results.json and raw/operation-DO-NOT-RUN.json is incomplete. Those files are retained immutable preparation snapshots. This v2 is the current proposed operation scope.
scope: Two stopped-target cases only: complete archive download, signature rejection with unchanged old bundle, then valid replacement. No target launch or relaunch.

required_host_effects.launchd: Fixture-specific transient updater/progress jobs and their helper processes; normal upstream behavior.
required_host_effects.caches: Fixture helper/download/installation caches outside the temporary root may use the user cache directory; private parent environment does not prove helper confinement.
required_host_effects.candidate_files: Download/extract/ownership/group/quarantine and timestamp handling plus replacement of the stopped temporary target. No installed application is a target.
required_host_effects.launchservices: The installer updates candidate modification/access timestamps to notify LaunchServices and the system, even without relaunch. Further registration/cache processing may occur.
required_host_effects.gatekeeper: On the prepared ad-hoc app same-volume path, source conditions permit /usr/bin/gktool scan of the candidate on macOS14.4+. This is a Gatekeeper assessment operation, not target execution.
required_host_effects.persistent_state_limit: Registration/assessment cache or policy state is not proven temporary or fully reversible. Job/cache cleanup alone would not prove all shared host state restored.

required_preflight: Fresh non-running fixture ID; exclusive owned loopbackserver; exact file hashes and private target parent; inventory fixture job/cache paths; no installed app or global settings touched; record fixture identities and assessment/registration receipts, keep all normal validation enabled, abort if the target is running
constraints: No Xcode build or repeated upstream shared-ID registration.
No target application execution or relaunch; no native input/clipboard or live sharing changes.
No installed app, TCC, login, account, firewall, DNS or global security-setting changes.
Do not suppress Gatekeeper scanning, timestamp notifications or validation to fit a narrower scope.
No identity-wide LaunchServices or execution-policy reversal; record effects and limits rather than promise restoration.
